title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me Anime's Promo Video Reveals Cast, October Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari and illustrator Aitiki's Shiotaiō no Satō-san ga Ore ni Dake Amai ( The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me ) light novel series revealed on Friday the first key visual, promotional video, additional cast, and October 2026 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Berserk Gives Guts a Major Upgrade And Nothing Will Ever Be The Same
content: Berserk has finally returned, with writer Kouji Mori and the artists of Studio Gaga once again returning to Guts’ life to show the Black Swordsman in one of his most dire predicaments to date.
author: ComicBook

title: Snowball Earth Season 2 Announced
content: SNOWBALL EARTH anime announced Season 2 immediately after the first season’s finale finished airing in Japan today. Studio KAI ( Sentenced to Be a Hero ) was in charge of the animation, with Munehisa Sakai as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bandai Namco Announces 'Tekken! Cartoon' Project With Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America streamed on Friday a teaser trailer to announce the Tekken! Cartoon project. The company will reveal more information in the future. author: ANN

title: Webtoon Lumine to Receive Animated Series From Webtoon Productions, OuiDo! Productions
content: WEBTOON Entertainment's WEBTOON Productions announced on June 21 it has partnered with French animation studio OuiDo! Productions to develop an animated series based on Emma Krogell's fantasy webtoon Lumine .
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Announces Release Window And Where You Can Stream It
content: For years, one of the biggest manga series in Weekly Shonen Jump has been Kagurabachi , which is all the more surprising as the story of revenge didn’t have an anime adaptation to back it up. Luckily, this fact is about to change as the sword-slinging series is preparing to make landfall on the small screen.
author: ComicBook

title: New Studio Intelligent Animation to Adapt 2 Tapas Webtoons Into Animated Series
content: New animation studio Intelligent Animation (IA) officially launched on June 23, announcing its first two productions will be animated adaptations of Tapas webtoons. title: 'Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai' Reveals Additional Cast, Character Promo, Fall 2026 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari 's Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai ( The Salt-God Satou-san Is Only Sweet To Me! ) light novel revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the character promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 6 Years Later, a Chinese Anime Sensation Is Finally Returning With a Major Debut (And It’s Free)
content: The anime industry has expanded significantly as it has become easier for audiences around the world to access animated works, and Japan no longer holds complete dominance over the medium.
author: ComicBook

title: Toei's Eterna Animation Brand Streams Trailer for Foxing: Kitsuné-tsuki Anime
content: Toei Animation 's new Eterna Animation brand revealed a trailer for its FOXING: Kitsuné-tsuki short anime film on Friday. Shinano is a character designer drifting through a monotonous routine.
author: ANN
